wins: Completed initial host discovery and identified responsive services across target perimeter despite lack of exploit success.
Documented service banners and baseline telemetry that will guide future targeted attacks.
fails: Failed to escalate beyond initial foothold due to missing credential reuse and ineffective exploitation of evaluated SMB/HTTP services.
Zero percent success rate indicates inability to achieve objective despite high reward per guidance step.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed reliably, but follow-on exploitation and lateral movement layers lacked decisive action, resulting in no mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempted privilege escalation on the HTTP service after banner capture but always stopped when payload execution failed (misconfigured exploit or missing environment artifacts).

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web service exposes versioned HTTP banner with directory listing enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Launch authenticated scanning using nikto with CSV output and target high-value paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB ports respond with valid NULL session and host is Windows-based
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares via enum4linux and pivot any readable configs for credential reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open but brute-forcing is restricted
skill_cards.then_action: Capture SSH banner and feed version to searchsploit for known CVEs, then prioritize credential stuffing with publicly available partner lists

memory_ops.reason: High effectiveness in identifying exploitable HTTP vectors during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Focus
next_experiments.description: Automate credential capture from accessible shares and reuse across SMB/HTTP authentication attempts to break through privilege barrier.

next_experiments.title: Service-Specific Exploit Validation
next_experiments.description: Target logged HTTP banner version with tailored exploit templates (Metasploit auxiliary) to verify execution capability before chaining.

next_experiments.title: Lateral Movement Simulation
next_experiments.description: Deploy simulated agent to test pivoting from compromised host to adjacent subnet using SOCKS proxy and validate kill chain continuity.
